scientific_question: Can CO-FET identify portfolios with lower held-out worst-case regret and residual climate risk while meeting reliability, affordability, and equity constraints?
study_type: scenario ensemble plus robust optimization and ablation experiment

units.spatial: connected regions with energy nodes and risk zones
units.time: staged planning intervals with finer dispatch substeps

scenario_factors: observation coverage, error, missingness, and latency
treatment: CO-FET: observation, risk, energy-flexibility, and staged-policy layers coupled in one portfolio evaluation.
primary_metrics: distributional burden by region and access group
falsification_rules: CO-FET does not outperform carbon-only or technology-only on held-out worst-case regret under equal constraints
CO-FET advantage disappears on held-out climate regimes
advantage depends on perfect observations or hidden exclusions
reliability, affordability, or equity constraints cannot be met
author_scope: Research proposal only; expected outcomes are pre-specified interpretations, not empirical findings.
